_comment: AWGN-FP ROW 0d / M3 complement population. Exact copy of ../../scenarios/s1-snr-ladder.json (same id 'S1', same 10 parts, same fixed base_freq_hz/dt_s) with 'trials' raised from 3 to 25 (30 -> 250 slots) so M3 ('the same quantity for genuine decodes') and ROW 0d ('M3 returns >= 200 genuine decodes') can be read from ONE render at usable N, per qa/rr-study/2026-09-02-1906-architect-to-qa-spec-awgn-fp-offline-replay.md Section 2/3/4. Reuses the shipped generator unmodified (harness.common.compute_seed('S1', part_index, trial_index)) -- trials 0-2 of every part reproduce the EXACT seeds the real S1 scenario has always used; trials 3-24 extend the same deterministic seed formula to new trial_index values, not a second noise/signal source. R&R-005's part range (-12..+15 dB) was chosen specifically because both appraisers decode >=95% of trials there, which is what ROW 0d's >=200-decode threshold relies on. Not used for any live sweep; offline-render-only.
name: SNR ladder (ROW 0d / M3 complement, N=25/part)
description: 10 parts x 25 trials (250 slots), R&R-005's >=95%-decode-rate range (-12..+15 dB), rendered offline for the AWGN-FP M3 genuine-decode complement.
